events.text: His own master kills him, in the end, for growing too strong. He does not die easily. He goes into the blade to wait, cold and patient, for the day he can face his master again on the far shore.

effects.log: You listen to the end, and the blade is quiet in your hand afterward.

events.text: What the spirit never told you: it does not love the dark arts. It loves being stronger than whatever hurt it. Those are not the same thing, and since meeting you it has started to know the difference.

events.text: "Report," says a voice from the blade at your hip, and you nearly drop it. "Never mind. I can see you have been slacking. Five seals, and I remember every one of them. We start drills at dawn."

effects.log: It settles into your hand as if it had never left.
"Your soul shines the same, every life," it says. "Once it is grown enough, I can see it from anywhere."

events.text: Your new blade starts humming the moment it is in your hand: a tune you have not heard for a lifetime, and know every note of. "I found you," Willow says, very softly. "It took a while. You are taller."

events.text: The blade in your hand laughs out loud. "There you are! I have been bored for an entire life. Do you have any idea how few people are worth fighting? Come on. Come on!"

events.text: {npc} left a hair ribbon on the bench by the well and walked off without it. It is still warm from {him}. You know exactly what a thing like this is worth, in your craft.

effects.log: You keep it.
You take it back to {npc}.

effects.log: You burn it in the brazier and watch until it is ash.

events.text: The signs said two threads crossing, and here they cross: {npc} steps out of a doorway and straight into you, and both of you stand there apologising far longer than the bump deserved.

effects.log: {He} listens with a half smile. "Then I suppose we had better see what it means," {he} says.

choices.text: Say nothing about it, and stay

effects.log: You say nothing about the signs. You stay.
You walk on. You think about {npc} for a long time afterward.
